Ravi matches the sheet: short black hair with a side part, thick straight brows, eyes that crease as he smiles, short trimmed beard, square jaw, light green shirt with rolled sleeves. He sits at a small round wooden table and holds his dark-blue phone up in his RIGHT hand on the viewer's left. His LEFT hand rests beside the tea cup on a coaster, and the watch is on that left wrist. This matches production.hands and heldBy ravi.right. His expression is a pleased, easy smile, as the scene asks.
Phone screen: one green chat-bubble card with a calendar icon, plus a tiny abstract status bar. There is no readable text, logo or number.

Padding: the side strips show no visible seam. The floor, baseboard and table read as continuous. The top wall has a very faint band of vertical streaking where the 420 px extension meets the original image (about 280-330 px down in the displayed image). On page-09.png this band falls entirely under the caption box, so readers cannot see it.
Lettering on page-09.png: the caption covers only plain wall. The FOLLOW-UP REMINDER label ends just above the phone. The phone, hand, face and hair are all clear.
Style: the line weight and flat cel shading are close to 07-1 and 08-5. Ravi's face has a few more fine wrinkle lines than on earlier pages, but it stays within the established look.
